label: Gavin Lake · full-estate 3D scene
subtitle: AFRF Gavin Lake · LidarBC terrain and CHM
source_note: LidarBC 2024 5 m DEM/CHM; public legacy block polygons; stems are synthetic at 700 TPH; no species inventory, so displayed as conifer. LidarBC CHM is valid over 75% of the block area; CHM no-data gaps use block-height fallback, not measured canopy.

method.terrain: 5 m LidarBC DEM bilinear sample; SRTM 1 arc-second in DEM no-data gaps
method.canopy: 5 m LidarBC CHM bilinear sample; block-height fallback in CHM no-data gaps
method.stem_placement: deterministic browser stems at block density inside block polygon
